title: 85. Permutation in String

examples.explanation: The substring "ba" is a permutation of "ab".
No permutation of "ab" appears as a contiguous substring in "eidboaoo".
The substring "cda" is a permutation of "adc".

hints: A permutation is determined by character frequencies, not character order.
Maintain a window in s2 whose length is exactly s1.length.
Update only the counts for the character entering and leaving the window.
